title: Collierville
lyrics:
A Tennessee town… the stories say
That nearly burned down… in Civil War days
A Bible town… we are today
Where church bells ring… to keep it that way

This is our home… a place we all share
We're very well known… cause we all care
Time has shown… with a little prayer
You're never alone… when you're on the square

In time we grew… from wagons & trails
Much of it new… from cotton bails
The work was true… this town would not fail
Even when moonshine… rushed its one jail

This is our home… a place we all share
We're very well known… cause we all care
Time has shown… with a little prayer
You're never alone… when you're on the square

Later a crime… a pain not wanted
Shots fired froze time… for some still haunted
God bless our blue line… they all responded
For you hearts climb… you are wanted

This is our home… a place we all share
We're very well known… cause we all care
Time has shown… with a little prayer
You're never alone… when you're on the square

With parks & trains… and even some bars
Where bluegrass reigns… with strings & guitars
Where Bibles & preachers… heal old scars
And all school teachers… are still rock stars

A town still small… a home we build
Where songs say y'all… and the wind is still
A town for us all… and for some a thrill
We're proud to still call… Collierville
bio: Collierville, TN: A town, church, square, and home.
